value: **Data & Comparative Modeling**: Investigates how learners build comparative models from large, unstructured, or socioeconomic datasets to construct evidence-based narratives. Evidence: "In this paper, we present the SourceML approach, teaching data bias by engaging students in building ML models with primary sources as text data in high school history classrooms."
